theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_cm_cutoff_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (y : Euclidean N) (h : Euclidean N → ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (A : ℕ → ℝ) (t R : ℝ), Measurable h → (∀ z, 0 ≤ h z ∧ h z ≤ 1) → (∀ j, Measurable (φ j)) → (∀ j s, 0 ≤ φ j s ∧ φ j s ≤ 1) → (∀ j s, s ≤ 1 → φ j s = 1) → (∀ j s, A j ^ 2 ≤ s → φ j s = 0) → (∀ j, 0 < A j) → Tendsto A atTop (𝓝 1) → 0 < t → (∀ j, t * A j ≤ R) → μ (closedBall y R) ≠ ∞ → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ z, φ j (‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) * h z ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z in closedBall y t, h z ∂μ))
